messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty ALERT — CRITICAL: High 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway (us-west-2)
- metric: http_5xx_rate (5m) = 8.2% (threshold 5%)
- triggered at 2026-03-17T21:59:60Z
- pager: https://pd.internal/p/ABC123
alice: Acked. I'm on call — moving this thread to #incident-sirenwave :eyes:
pagerduty-bot: Assigned to alice — acknowledgement recorded
alice: Quick glance at perf graphs: spikes across gw-frontends and model-host-12. Latency also increased. https://metrics.internal/r/xyz
ben: Oncall SRE stepping in. tailing gateway logs now
ben: Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T21:59:45Z inference-gw[proxy]: upstream_response: 502 model-host-12
2026-03-17T21:59:46Z inference-gw[proxy]: kv_cache_miss key="prompt-prefix-..." host=model-host-12
2026-03-17T21:59:47Z sidecar[kvcache]: eviction_rate=0.23 host=model-host-12
```
carla: Noticed autoscaler recently added instances to dedicated pool for embeddings-route — warm-up churn could be surfacing 502s if sidecar not warmed.
alice: Good call. Ben, can you check sidecar health + restart if needed? I'll start a temporary traffic slice to low-latency pool.
ben: Running health check on model-host-12 sidecar
`curl -fsS http://model-host-12.local:9100/health || echo FAIL`
ben: health check returned FAIL. Restarting sidecar now:
`ssh model-host-12 sudo systemctl restart kvcache-sidecar`
pagerduty-bot: Note: incident escalated to SRE lead (dave) because error floor remained >2% after initial mitigation
dave: Joining. Any evidence of config change or deploy? timeline?
carla: No deploys in last 30m. Autoscaler initiated scale-up at 21:58:30Z. Sidecar eviction + cache warmup correlation visible.
alice: I initiated a route-swap to move ~30% of traffic off model-host-12 to our backup pool. Hitting internal route API now.
`POST https://infra.internal/api/route_swap {"from":"model-host-12","to":"usw2-backup","weight":0.3}`
ben: Route swap returned 200 OK. Monitoring shift.
ben: After restart + route swap, observed error rate drop to ~3.1% within 60s. Latency normalizing.
carla: Suggest applying temporary concurrency cap on embeddings route (concurrency: 8 -> 5) to reduce load during warmup.
alice: Applied concurrency cap cfg-9923 via console (route embeddings/v2). Confirmed rollout id cfg-9923
ben: sidecar on model-host-12 finished warmup, eviction_rate trending down, cache hit rate improving.
alice: Error rate steady at 1.4% over last 2m. No additional customer tickets yet, but CS flagged brief 5xx spikes for ~10 customers earlier.
dave: Good mitigation. Keep watch 10m. If stable, mark resolved and file postmortem ticket.
incidentbot: Runbook reminder: Inference 5xx runbook — https://runbooks.internal/inference-5xx
carla: Filing postmortem placeholder: PM-4567 (will add timeline + root cause analysis)
alice: Will keep monitoring. If error rate stays <2% for 10m, I'll resolve. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by alice, resolved by alice at 2026-03-17T22:08:00Z
alice: resolved
